propositions: When acceptance criteria no longer match reality due to code changes or auto-generation, the completion verifier blocks close with no documented legitimate path forward.
Closing against stale criteria via --force-close or --ref to an old commit leaves inaccurate state in the ticket system because the ticket record claims something untrue of the codebase.
The correct remediation is to edit the ticket so criteria are accurate, re-pass plan-review gate, then close against corrected criteria to ensure the record is truthful.
Documentation must state explicitly that --force-close and --ref workarounds for invalidated criteria are incorrect solutions and produce inaccurate ticket state.

The plan-review close gate's stale-regver check creates a secondary stranding problem: completed merged work cannot close if the criteria registry changed since plan review, forcing re-review of already-executed plans.
